title: Text animations
summary: Title cards and text overlays in the horror title-sequence look: bone-white condensed capitals, small and widely tracked on near-black, with a single rose letter. Letters switch on one at a time in random order under a failing lamp, the accent letter drops into the baseline late, and lines leave as vertical streaks.
usage: Title cards fill the frame (any shape from square to 9:16): use one as a shot's "background", e.g. {"background": {"piece": "text/headline-slam", "props": {"lines": ["YOUR", "WORDS"], "field": "slate"}}}, or as a footage "cutaway". Fields: slate, void, cold, blood, mist (field and colour names from other themes are mapped onto these). Overlays are see-through, in 1080×1920 frame pixels: {"piece": "text/keyword-slam", "start": 1.2, "end": 3.4, "props": {"word": "LISTEN", "y": 330}}. Every word, colour and position is a prop. Kit: library/themes/horror/kit.js. Files: library/themes/horror/text/pieces/.

items.name: Headline
items.description: A headline switching on letter by letter in random order under a failing lamp, with a tracked line above, a note and one rose letter per line.

items.name: Split stack
items.description: Two words stacked either side of a hairline that draws itself across the dark; the second word arrives late.

items.name: Whisper wall
items.description: Rows of the same few phrases drifting past each other, barely lit, one row at a time coming up to full brightness.

items.name: Statement
items.description: A sentence assembling itself out of the dark letter by letter; the words you pick come up in rose.

items.name: Big number
items.description: One large figure rolling through wrong digits before it settles, with a tracked line above and a label below.

items.name: Transcript quote
items.description: A quotation typed out on a worn typewriter beside a thin rose rule, then who said it.

items.name: Case list
items.description: A numbered list read off one line at a time; the current line is bright, the earlier ones fall back to grey.

items.name: Versus
items.description: Two accounts one above the other, split by a hairline: one lit cold, one lit dark red.

items.name: Chapter
items.description: A chapter card: the number huge and barely there in outline, behind a small tracked line and the title.

items.name: Film-leader countdown
items.description: Numbers cutting in under lamp flashes inside a thin ring with a sweeping hand, then the go word.

items.name: End card
items.description: The sign-off on black: the lines come up while a lamp behind them catches and fails, then the handle in rose.

items.name: Keyword
items.description: One word over the footage, switching on in a pool of shadow and leaving as vertical streaks.

items.name: Scratched highlight
items.description: A sentence over the footage; the marked words turn rose and a rough line is scratched under them.

items.name: Lower third
items.description: Names the speaker: a short rose bar, the name in tracked capitals and the role beneath.

items.name: Side text
items.description: Tracked capitals running up one edge of the frame beside a hairline.

items.name: Crawl band
items.description: A dark band with a line of capitals crawling through it between two hairlines.

items.name: Corner labels
items.description: Four small tracked labels in the corners, each by a short tick, stuttering on one after another.

items.name: Exhibit frame
items.description: An unsteady thin border with corner ticks, a typewritten label tab and a caption, for an inset picture.

items.name: Rubber stamp
items.description: A worn round stamp thumped onto the footage, with a word across it and small text round the ring.
